scope: Bounded local reconciliation of explicitly indexed preserved receipts; not exhaustive conversation/tool/provider accounting

consumers_and_update.scope: Explicit own-S2 execution state in ledger row75, consistent with failed native prepare and absent candidate/binding. No consumer/update execution total is inferred from other-session evidence.

publication_attempts.result: No remote tree write from these rejected requests

forbidden_inferences: No filesystem-copy count is treated as another call.
No late archival observation is treated as a new send.
No semantic PASS is promoted to runtime, consumer, CI or global acceptance.
No raw judge reasoning or reserved consumer expected answers appear in this index.

construction.limits: L4 app and entry were one author activation with two artifact requests. Supplement text count is not a native call count. Support/coordination followups are not exhaustively indexed.

corrections.limit: Four ledger-backed correction batches; additional followup/scope-addition messages inside a batch are not promoted to unobserved exact call totals.

literal_review_transport.definition: Original/no-known-invalidation describes the payload history, not guaranteed delivery. An empty return without reported error is not a received-byte attestation.
literal_review_transport.deduplication: One canonical preserved receipt per group, selected by exact path and SHA256; copies in producer/staging/history locations are not extra calls. Distinct per-group ordinals, including same-payload replacements, remain distinct actual logical calls.

judges.limits: Response documents are real preserved results, not inferred executions. Initial L1 J2 desktop, J2 desktop/design and both app-r3 review activations lack standalone dispatched-call receipts in this bounded index; their actual response documents remain present. Closure review is outside this preclosure snapshot.

native_prepare.scope: Own S2 final package only; prior setup/typecheck and other-session sample operations are not additional S2 prepare calls

readbacks.limits: The four named batches are9 captured logical GET results, not a global read total. The additional catalog is non-additive: matching hashes collapse preserved copies, but separate repeated GETs can produce identical bytes. Initial source captures, all historical reads and every root/support tool call are not fully reconciled here.

historical_original_session.limit: These68 historical producer-relay calls are retained evidence, not newly issued calls and not the full original-session or campaign total.

local_gap_disposition.effect: Do not infer an exact activation total or unobserved spend.
